name: Paliperidone Palmitate
summary: Invega Sustenna is a once-a-month injection of the antipsychotic paliperidone, used for long-term control of schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder.
description: Paliperidone palmitate (Invega Sustenna) is the once-monthly form of paliperidone, a newer (atypical) antipsychotic. It is an inactive form (the palmitate ester prodrug) that the body turns into paliperidone, which is the active breakdown product of risperidone. Monthly injections into a muscle keep steady levels of medicine in your blood, which helps with taking it regularly and with long-term symptom control in schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder. It works mainly by blocking dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Paliperidone palmitate (Invega Sustenna) is the once-monthly formulation of paliperidone, an atypical antipsychotic. It is the palmitate ester prodrug of paliperidone, which is the active metabolite of risperidone. Invega Sustenna provides sustained therapeutic plasma levels with monthly intramuscular injections, supporting adherence and long-term symptom control in schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder. The drug exerts its effect primarily through antagonism of dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors.
